THE_ARCHITECT.talk.USURER-USURER.0-0r.ch: Every stone of your Spire was mortared with unpaid blood and compound interest.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.USURER-USURER.0-1r.an: You keep a ledger of mortals, broker, yet even your gold turns to dust at the summit.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.USURER-USURER.1-0r.ch: Your account is in default, Architect. I am here to foreclose on eternity!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.USURER-USURER.1-1r.an: Then weigh your scales against the Spire.
